```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(colorspace)
library(ggtext)
library(extrafont)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}

DBD_EVMP_UNOS_regions_corrected_raw <- read_excel("DBD EVMP UNOS regions_corrected.xlsx")


UNOS_regions <- 
  #Import Shivank's data from UNOS regions into R
  read_excel("DBD EVMP UNOS regions_corrected.xlsx")%>%
  #Split column that contains Regions and which states they contain
  separate(Region, c("Region", "B"),sep=":") %>%
  #Split list of states into 7 separate variables
  separate(B, c("State1","State2","State3","State4", "State5", "State6", "State7"), sep=",") %>%
  #Trim leading spaces
  mutate_at(vars(contains("State")), str_trim) %>%
  #Change to long format and drop extraneous variable that results
   pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("State"),
   names_to = "StateNumber",
   values_to = "State",
   values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  select(-StateNumber)%>%
  mutate(Percentage=100*Percentage)


```


```{r}

#Import State level mapping data
us_states <- read_sf("cb_2018_us_state_20m/cb_2018_us_state_20m.shp") %>%
  select(NAME, geometry) %>%
  filter(!(NAME %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico"))) %>%
  rename(State=NAME)


```

```{r}

UNOS_region_labels <- read_excel("UNOS region labels.xlsx")

Transplant_centers <- read_csv("Transplant centers.csv") %>%
  select(OTCName, OrganTransplantationCenterServiceTypeDescription, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  filter(OrganTransplantationCenterServiceTypeDescription=="Heart")

```

```{r}
MergedStates<-inner_join(UNOS_regions, us_states, by="State") %>%st_as_sf()

UNOS_region_map<-MergedStates%>%  
  group_by(Region) %>% 
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry))

```

```{r}

ShivankEVMPMap<-ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=MergedStates,mapping=aes(fill = Percentage), 
                                color="black", size = 0.25)+
  geom_sf(data=UNOS_region_map,color="black", fill=NA, size = 1)+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette = "OrYel")+ 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Percentage of transplants"))

ggsave("ShivankEVMPMap.png", 
       plot=ShivankEVMPMap)

```
```{r}
#Will add transplant centers to map
ShivankEVMPMapwithcenter<-ggplot()+
    geom_sf(data=MergedStates,mapping=aes(fill = Percentage), 
            color="#838383", size = 0.25)+
    geom_sf(data=UNOS_region_map,color="black", fill=NA, size = 1)+
    geom_jitter(data=Transplant_centers, mapping=aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude), alpha=0.5, 
                height = 0.3, width = 0.3) +
    theme_void()+
    scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette = "OrYel",
                                     breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15), 
                                   labels = c("0%", "5%", "10%", "15%")
                                     )

ggsave("ShivankEVMPMapwithcenter.png", 
       plot=ShivankEVMPMapwithcenter)
```

```{r}

MergedStates%>%ggplot()+geom_sf(mapping=aes(fill = Percentage), 
                                color="white")+theme_void()+
  scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = "Purple-Green")

ShivankEVMPMapPlot3<-ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=MergedStates,mapping=aes(fill = Percentage), 
                                color="black", size = 0.25)+
  geom_sf(data=UNOS_region_map,color="black", fill=NA, size = 1)+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette = "OrYel")+ 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Percentage"))+
  geom_richtext(data=UNOS_region_labels, fill = NA, color="blue", label.color = NA, 
                mapping=aes(x=Lon, y=Lat, label=Region, family="Comic Sans MS"))
ggsave("ShivankEVMPMapPlot3.png", 
       plot=ShivankEVMPMapPlot3)

```
